name: Editor-Tab Pages
description: Full editor-tab webview pages + the "Tools" sidebar action bar. pagePanel.ts is the generic singleton WebviewPanel host (showPage/getPage, one reusable tab per viewType; re-invoking reveals + fires onReveal). Pages: search results (searchPanel.ts), the three code-health scans (scanPages.ts — SCAN_PAGES feature table, same scan/ack/exclude RPC set the old sidebar scan views had, auto-scan on open, re-scan on reveal; duplicates scan attaches per-member snippets via snippets.ts widenSnippet), and the tasks board (tasksPage.ts — reuses buildTaskRpcHandlers/taskPanelContext from tasksView.ts). The old Dead Code / Duplicates / Type Safety sidebar WebviewViews were REMOVED (scanViewProvider.ts, deadCodeView.ts, duplicatesView.ts, typeEscapeView.ts are gone); codeHealthView.ts is a native TreeView action bar whose items run the unchanged command ids (codeWorkbench.deadCode.scan etc.), which now open pages. The page-opening commands are registered in commands/pageCommands.ts. Webview side: webview/bridge.ts has a generic call<T>, a typed per-entry event map (onEvents<E>) and mountApp(); the three scan entries are 3-line createScanApp(Panel) files (webview/scanEntry.tsx).
guidelines: New full-page views go through pagePanel.showPage — never hand-roll a createWebviewPanel singleton.
Pages reuse the existing dist/webview/<entry> bundles; sidebar and page surfaces must answer the same RPC set so the shared ui components stay host-agnostic.
Snippet widening is best-effort file reads (snippets.ts) — keep the ranking/compact data as fallback.
Command ids for the scans are unchanged (codeWorkbench.*.scan) — they now open pages; don't add parallel command ids.

Webview entries: declare a per-entry event map and use bridge.onEvents<E>(...) (no payload casts), let bridge.call<T> infer from the API type (no `as Promise<…>`), and mount with mountApp(<App />) instead of getElementById('root')!.
anti_patterns: Do not cast bridge.call results or event payloads in entries — type the event map / generic instead.
Do not copy the scan entry boilerplate — new scan pages use createScanApp.
decisions: Sidebar scan views were replaced by editor-tab pages driven by a single feature table (SCAN_PAGES in scanPages.ts).
Webview bridge got typed events + mountApp (2026-10) to remove ~20 type-escape casts.
